verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Pass Monitor as a built-in feature that scans the dark web for credential leaks, checks the health of stored passwords, and reminds users to enable 2FA, which covers the core of breach and weak-credential warnings. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that weak and reused passwords are flagged separately, detail on how users are notified of a breached service, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
